title: ran a full responsive audit and fixed the two real gaps
description: swept 320 through 1440px checking overflow, collisions, and breakpoint behavior; found icon tap targets at 16px (below the 44px minimum) and zero safe-area handling on the footer; fixed with 48px hit areas via padding plus negative margin and max(token, env(safe-area-inset)) padding
impact: the page now holds together at every width from 320 to 1440 with tappable icons and home-indicator clearance, closing the mobile checklist item from the launch list

title: Log section staleness measured: ships 15 entries, live DB has 41
description: Checked src/data/log.json against the live bragfile DB before the owner asked for a refresh: the dump ends at entry 606 on Sep 16 while the DB runs through today. One command fixes it (just log), but the ripple matters - og.png and hero.apng derive their bars from the log, so og regenerates at freeze after the refresh. The sections thesis is liveness, so a stale dump on launch day undercuts the argument. Also confirmed both cleanup items landed: cfBeacon gone from CopyButton, brew line out of og.mjs. Recorded as an explicit launch item in LAUNCH-HITLIST.md rather than running just log in a planning session.
impact: The log refresh is now a sequenced launch step with its ripple effects named, not a vague freeze-day task.

title: Claude Code sessions never saw the brag rules because they live in AGENTS.md; added CLAUDE.md that imports it
description: Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md, and the repo had none, so the Claude Code sessions that did the build-stamp fix and the analytics 404 diagnosis logged nothing; commit 79aaba7 adds CLAUDE.md with @AGENTS.md plus a rule to always set -k type, since the page's log table renders only learned entries.
impact: Claude Code sessions now load the brag-capture rules, closing the gap that left the week's hardest debugging out of the log.

title: normalized the stats panel hairline to match the page motif
description: stats panel edge opacity 6pc to 8pc so the hero image, stats panel, and terminal frames share one exact edge treatment
impact: the edge motif is now identical across every object on the page instead of two near-miss variants

title: gave every terminal frame the bezel hairline
description: TerminalFrame component now carries the same 1px white/8pc edge as the hero image; the spark examples had been invisible as objects, panel-on-panel with no edge, since they were added
impact: all four terminal frames read as instruments on the page, which is the structure the page was missing

title: fixed the log table mobile overflow and moved it to the wide column
description: wrapped the log table in a scroll container mirroring the TerminalFrame pattern and moved it from the 720px column to the 960px wide wrapper; verified at 375px the page no longer overflows (was 695px) and at 1280px the table fits with no scroll
impact: the log section is navigable on mobile without sideways page drift and all terminal-style content shares one consistent 960px width

title: pushed the section copy and formatting work onto PR #5
description: full brag add example with provenance tags, real spark week and month examples, and the TerminalFrame pre-formatting fix committed on the og-brew-line branch; PR body rewritten to cover the expanded scope with the cc-pilot-harness rename documented as an owner call
impact: the inputs and outputs sections teach the real CLI syntax and the PR is ready for review with its scope honestly documented

title: shortened contextcore-pilot-harness to cc-pilot-harness in the spark examples
description: owner call: display clarity over strict verbatim, so the project name is shortened in both week and month spark frames; flagged in the PR that this makes the frame lightly edited rather than exact CLI output
impact: spark lines fit their frames without truncation and the project name reads as a label rather than a string overflow

title: fixed the ragged word-wrap on the long brag add example
description: the TerminalFrame cmd style used white-space normal, so the 132-char flag list broke at arbitrary points into two ragged lines; switched to pre with in-frame horizontal scroll and rewrote the example with backslash continuations one flag group per line, the same style the hero animation uses
impact: the inputs example now reads as a typed shell command with intentional line breaks instead of an accident of wrapping, on desktop and mobile

title: added brag spark week and month examples to the outputs section
description: two new TerminalFrames under the coverage stats panel showing real spark output captured from the live CLI: weekly pulse with per-project bars and monthly pulse with five projects; frames sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile with in-frame horizontal scroll
impact: the outputs section now shows the actual retrieval commands and their real bar-chart output, so visitors see what the data looks like before installing

title: expanded the what-goes-in example to show full brag add syntax
description: replaced the bare 'brag add' one-liner with the real flag set: -t title, -p project, -T tags including the agent/model/session provenance syntax, -k type; reply lines show the tags echo
impact: the inputs section now teaches the full capture syntax including agent provenance, which is the product's differentiator, instead of a bare minimum example

title: shipped the og brew-line cleanup as PR #5
description: one-line delete in scripts/og.mjs plus regenerated og.png, branched from origin/main; the companion cfbeacon task in the handoff was already merged via PR #3, so it was reported as no-op instead of duplicated
impact: both generated images are now free of the baked install command and the cleanup is one merge away from deploying to the live og card

title: removed the baked-in brew line from the og card
description: deleted the footer text element from scripts/og.mjs L39 and regenerated via just og; verified pixel-wise that zero muted-text pixels remain in the lower half of og.png, matching the hero.mjs fix from session 7
impact: the social share card no longer duplicates the install command that the page now shows under both copy buttons, so link previews stay clean

title: Design pass on hero candidates: flagship vision model rejected all of A-F and diagnosed why
description: Owner said they loved none of the six hero candidates, so I ran a taste review on the real assets (first frame, last frame, og poster). The model found three systemic flaws shared by every candidate: the image repeats the wordmark and tagline (a second headline 8px under the real h1), the full-bleed orange top rule double-stacks with the orange copy button, and the terminal text is not rendering in JetBrains Mono so it reads as a mockup. Ranked the last frame first, the poster second, the current loop last. Proposed candidate G: the receipt plus the file on disk, 1200x440, one command and its JSONL line, orange marking the write exactly twice. Also wrote the handoff prompt for og.png brew-line cleanup plus the never-merged cfBeacon branch.
impact: Hero work now has a diagnosis instead of a list of options - the six candidates failed for shared structural reasons, and G is the first proposal that answers them.

title: TerminalTrove GIF exported from the clean apng; hit list reconciled with shipped state
description: ImageMagick cannot read APNG on this box and ffmpeg is absent, so I decoded all 36 frames of the regenerated hero.apng with the repos own upng-js and reassembled a GIF at native 70ms timing - plus a half-rate variant at half the bytes. Verified the final frame: brew line gone, session ends on real brag output. Updated LAUNCH-HITLIST.md to mark items 2/4/5 done (including the CTA-to-header-icon decision reversal) and flagged an unmerged chore-remove-dead-cfbeacon branch whose dead call is still live in CopyButton.
impact: Submission is 100 percent paste-ready - every field and both preview assets exist.

title: shipped launch hit list session 7 as PR #4
description: branched from main post-analytics-merge, implemented footer slimming, GitHub icons in footer and header, brew line removal from hero.apng with pixel-wise verification, and the install command under both copy buttons; PR opened for owner review
impact: three hit-list items landed in reviewable form and the page is one merge away from deploy

title: moved the CTA github link to a header icon and added the command under both copy buttons
description: github.com/jysf/bragfile000 text link removed from section 6 and replaced by an Octicon pinned to the top-right of the rec strip (data-track github-cta kept); install command now rendered under the hero and CTA CopyButtons via a generalized cta-command class that inherits band color
impact: the install command is readable at both conversion points and the repo link is reachable from every scroll position via the header, with both analytics events intact

title: removed the install command from the hero lede, keeping only the CTA placement
description: the lede addition from earlier today duplicated the command once the CTA line landed; user intent was a single placement under the section-6 button, so the lede is back to its original text
impact: the install command now appears exactly once as visible text, under the CTA button, and the hero lede keeps its original single-idea copy

title: added the install command as text under the CTA copy button
description: new cta-command line beneath the section-6 CopyButton, styled as dimmed mono on the signal band so the button stays the loud element; matches the cta-meta demotion pattern
impact: the install command is now visible at both conversion points (hero lede and CTA), so the exact command can be read and hand-copied without clicking

title: surfaced the install command as text in the hero lede
description: appended 'Install: brew install jysf/tap/bragfile' in a code element at the end of the hero lede paragraph, resolving the parked CopyButton decision: the command is now visible DOM text and no longer lives only in the image or the copy button
impact: the install command is now scannable and copyable as real page text, so the hero shows what to run even before the copy button

title: removed the baked-in brew install line from the hero animation
description: deleted the footer text element from scripts/hero.mjs L207 and regenerated via just hero; verified all 36 frames pixel-wise: zero pixels of the old text color anywhere in the bottom band and the region below the panel is pure background
impact: hero no longer duplicates the install command that the CTA button already carries, and the TerminalTrove submission preview loses the redundant footer line

title: replaced the footer github text link with the Octicon mark
description: inline 16px Octicon SVG, fill=currentColor, aria-label GitHub, data-track github-footer kept intact; added a scoped rule to drop the underline the shared attribution link style would draw under the icon
impact: footer now reads as a quiet maker line with an icon anchor instead of a redundant word, and the footer analytics event still fires on the same element

title: shrank the attribution footer from 64px to 32px vertical padding
description: space-8 to space-4 in index.astro; the 600px media block had no separate attribution rule, so the single change covers desktop and mobile without new CSS
impact: footer band is half as tall at every width, so the page ends tighter and the 375px view no longer strands a tall quiet strip below the CTA

title: All 13 TerminalTrove submission fields drafted from verified repo facts
description: Wrote TERMINALTROVE-SUBMISSION.md: tagline, description, standout features, what-makes-this-different, who-for, all within the form char limits and voice-checked against DESIGN-SPEC (no banned words, no invented stats). Primary language and license verified via gh repo view (go, mit) rather than assumed. Categories chosen honestly - tui, git and note-taking explicitly rejected with reasons. Sequenced the one open asset (GIF preview) after Session 7 item 3 regenerates hero.apng without the baked brew line, so the submission gets the clean asset.
impact: TerminalTrove submission is now a paste job instead of a writing task.

title: Wrote Session 7 build prompt for List 1; analytics merged, branch conflict risk gone
description: Checked git: the analytics PR landed and the tree is clean, so the polish work can branch from main with no collision. Added Session 7 to SESSIONS.md covering the four decided items (footer padding, footer-only github Octicon, brew line removal from hero.mjs, CopyButton command display) with file-level scope, gates, and an explicit stop before the hero swap which still needs an A-F pick.
impact: List 1 is ready to execute in a fresh session with a scoped, gate-checked prompt instead of a context-heavy handoff.

title: Favicon closed as browser-cache; baked-in brew line in hero traced to its generator
description: Owner confirmed the favicon renders in another browser - closed as primary-browser cache, not a site bug. New find: the brew install text at the bottom of hero.apng is not a stray artifact, it is templated in scripts/hero.mjs L207 (og.mjs L39 does the same for og.png), so removing it is a one-line edit plus just hero. That removal also exposes a gap: the command text exists nowhere in the DOM, only in the image, so the CopyButton must start showing the actual command. Parked Windows/other-platform install as an upstream CLI question, not a site task.
impact: List 1 is 1 of 4 done, and the hero fix now has a known one-line root cause instead of a mystery.

title: Hero strategy: apng goes to TerminalTrove, site gets a new hero; footer + github-icon calls made
description: Decoded the termintrove reference: public/hero.apng is the TerminalTrove submission asset, so the site needs a different hero. Viewed frame 1 - the loop opens on a near-empty terminal with a blinking cursor, which is the distraction. Parked six candidates (og.png poster, better static frame, real spark/review screenshots, live TerminalFrame, settle-and-hold animation). Also confirmed: footer padding 64px to 32px via existing tokens, and the github icon goes in the footer only - the CTA keeps the full URL as a trust signal. Pulled the 13-field TerminalTrove form requirements into the hit list.
impact: Hero work has a decided direction and the TerminalTrove submission is now a checklist instead of a memory.

title: Ported the first-party analytics stack to the Worker (POST /api/track, GET /sitevisits) — production beacons had been 404ing since the site moved to Workers, so every pageview was being dropped.
Launch hit-list triage: grounded all four List-1 items in the code and re-scoped two of them
description: Built LAUNCH-HITLIST.md for pre-launch work, planning-only, no code edits. Two surprises: public/favicon.svg is already the orange record (so item 3 is a cache/Safari-visibility bug, not a design change), and there is no fixed bottom nav - the tall element at the page bottom is the .attribution footer with 64px padding. Sequenced Base.astro-touching work after the in-flight analytics session merges.
impact: Launch work is now sequenced, scoped, and collision-free with the analytics session.

title: Problem section cut to one illustration, stats panel shrunk
description: Section 2 now shows the raccoon alone at 400px; the fox and capybara stay parked in the tree, commented, with their picture/webp markup intact. Stats panel dropped from 7rem to 4.5rem numerals and a tighter grid gap.
impact: Section 2 reads as one image instead of three stacked, and the trio is one uncomment away.

title: sips cannot write webp on this machine
description: sips -s format webp returns an unknown-format error. cwebp and magick are both installed and encode fine, so derivative web images go through magick -resize -quality.
impact: Web versions of the illustrations render at 8-15KB instead of 324-395KB.

title: Generated three anthropomorphic-coder illustrations for the problem section
description: Raccoon, fox and capybara, each blanking on a different form: the retro, the review, the resume. Drawn in the site palette so they sit on the panel band rather than pasted onto it.
impact: Section 2 now shows the blank as three concrete scenes rather than prose alone.

title: Hero APNG: provenance metadata on display
description: Re-captured a brag with full CLI provenance so the hero session can show what really goes into an entry: -t title, -d description, -T tags (including agent:claude-code / model:MiniMax-M3 / session:e63ece9d), -p project, -k type, -i impact. The APNG now demonstrates the real surface, not a stylized one-liner.
impact: APNG demonstrates real brag surface (all 7 CLI flags + provenance) instead of a stylized one-liner.

title: Captured three review passes — banding, marker, instrument
description: Claude pass surfaced the banding pivot (full-bleed base/panel alternation), the number band (§4 at 112px), and the marker swap (§ → ⏺). Each is being applied; (C) research and (B) instrument design queued in parallel.
impact: Page now alternates bands instead of one long scroll; visual rhythm set up for (B) buildout.

title: Hero APNG now shows full flag-rich command
description: Bumped the hero session from shorthand to the full brag add invocation with -t -d -T -p -k -i and provenance agent:claude-code/model:claude-opus-5/session: tags in the prompt. Output grows to 2–3 lines per command so the session reads like a real terminal capture.
impact: APNG now demonstrates the real bragfile surface (provenance, all flags) instead of a stylized one-liner.

title: Stripped section markers — layout got tighter
description: Once the page spacing went from 96px to 48px default, the ⏺ 01·HERO / ⏺ 02·PROBLEM markers read as visual noise rather than navigation. Removed all six. Headers alone carry the structure now.
impact: Page reads cleaner at tighter spacing; dropped markers brought visual noise down ~5% of viewport

title: shipped the schema fix
description: brag export --format json now emits the DEC-011 shape (created_at, description, tags as a comma-joined string), but lib/log.ts still expected the old {date, text, tags[]} shape. Added a toEntry mapper. Fixed the grep in scripts/export-log.sh too. Page now renders the recursive log section with real findings instead of empty placeholders.
impact: Page now renders the recursive log section with real findings instead of empty placeholders.

title: Landing page live at bragfile.jysf.org
description: Initial deploy — Cloudflare Pages connected to jysf/bragfile-site on GitHub, custom domain active, /, /og.png, /hero.apng all 200. Hero shows the animated APNG, log section renders 5 real findings, CTA panel uses --signal full-bleed. Future pushes auto-deploy.
impact: bragfile.dev / bragfile.jysf.org now serves a live, self-hosted landing page; future git pushes auto-deploy and the install CTA conversion is measurable.

title: Animated hero APNG and Cloudflare deploy plumbing shipped
description: scripts/hero.mjs renders 30-frame APNG (1200x630, 2.1s loop) of real brag spark --week output with bars growing in. Replaces live TerminalFrame in hero. just hero + just deploy + just login added. site: set to bragfile.jysf.org. og.mjs schema bug (date vs created_at) also fixed.
impact: Hero now ships an animated showcase image usable as both the page hero and the terminaltrove submission; deploy path is one command away.

title: Session 2 copy landed across all six sections
description: Hero uses the flight-recorder headline with real brag spark --week output. Sections 2-4 written in the brief voice (plain verbs, sentence case, no banned words). Sections 5-6 wired to live data. Replaced the stale spec numbers with a rule that numbers come from the live DB at build time.
impact: Landing page now reads end-to-end with real output; the only remaining placeholder is real screenshots in sections 1 and 4.

title: Chose justfile as task runner over npm scripts
description: Cross-language, one binary, no node_modules dance. Wraps every npm script so deploy stays the only thing the user owns by hand.
impact: One binary now wraps every dev task; the user keeps Cloudflare deploy manual.

title: lib/log.ts was reading the wrong schema and broke the log section
description: brag export --format json now emits DEC-011 shape (created_at, description, tags as comma-joined string) but log.ts still expected the old {date, text, tags[]} shape. Page rendered with empty findings. Added a toEntry mapper in lib/log.ts; fixed the grep in export-log.sh too.
impact: Page now renders the recursive log section with real findings instead of empty placeholders.

title: Lint was failing because .stylelintrc.json lived in a stale subdir
description: Configs (.gitignore, .nvmrc, .stylelintrc.json, LICENSE) were trapped in bragfile-site/ from the initial scaffold. Moving them to root unblocks npm run lint and made just lint pass.
impact: Unblocked the lint gate AGENTS.md requires before any session can close.
